name: busywatch
author: Thies C. Arntzen
description: The busywatch history UI, drawn natively in the Omarchy shell: cpu/memory/io stall, load, clock, heat and power over 15m to 30d, the top apps stacked over time, and a drilldown for any one of them. Needs a busywatch daemon serving its read-only API on loopback.

barWidget.description: A dot in the colour of whatever is stalling; the history window opens on click.

schema.label: busywatch host
schema.description: Where the busywatch web API is listening. The daemon binds loopback unless told otherwise.

schema.label: Port
schema.description: The port busywatch was started with (`--web [ADDR:]PORT`). The shipped systemd unit uses 8787.

schema.label: Bar refresh every (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar dot re-reads the live pressures. The history window polls every 15 seconds on its own while it is open.
